details:
I was trying to join one of my friends, the first time I was trying to join them I got into the instance, but before I got in I had clicked the "join" button a few times and got the "unable to join this instance" error a few times beforeI was able to join their instance. Shortly after joining (within a second or two) the entire screen went black including the UI.
I restarted my client since I couldn't see anything. After restarting the client I tried joining them again but got the error similar to "unable to join this instance" after a few attempts I went and joined another friend.
A little later I tried to join them again, and I was able to load into the world, but the world didn't load correctly, I got another error and was booted to the "Error World"
